description: This file contains functions for installing and configuring AdvancedOpenPortal (AOP) integration in SuiteCRM, including setting up hooks, templates, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: install_aop
methods.description: Initializes AOP configuration, loads email templates, and installs hooks.

methods.name: installAOPHooks
methods.description: Sets up logic hooks for various modules like Contacts, Cases, and Emails.

methods.name: getTemplates
methods.description: Returns an array of predefined email templates used in AOP.
